messages:
alex: opened a docs PR to document air-gapped mirror signing + apt/rpm repo creation for private installs. customers asked for a reproducible example with offline gpg signing, apt-ftparchive, and repository retention cleanup. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4320 :memo:

priya: nice. can you include steps for repeatable checksums and how to verify bundle integrity on the isolated host? we had one customer ship the wrong bundle last quarter.

alex: yes — plan is to add a `verify-bundle.sh` script example and a minimal systemd unit to run preflight. i'll also show sha256sum + detached gpg signature usage. snippet i'll include:```
# create detached signature
gpg --batch --yes --output bundle.tar.gz.sig --detach-sign --armor bundle.tar.gz
# verify on target (with imported public key)
gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
# check checksum
sha256sum -c bundle.tar.gz.sha256
```

dmitri: for rpm repos remember to show `createrepo_c --update` vs full `createrepo_c` and mention metadata expiration. customers hit stale metadata in cron'd mirror updates.

lia: also add a note about GPG key provisioning for on-prem: we recommend a KMS-backed offline signer option and an HSM PKCS11 example. small snippet:```
# example using pkcs11-tool to list tokens
pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
# sign with openssl using engine pkcs11 (example only)
openssl pkeyutl -inkey "pkcs11:token=signer;object=repo-signer" -sign -in bundle.tar.gz -out bundle.sig
```

priya: good. add troubleshooting steps for PKCS11 licensing quirks — some HSM providers return truncated serial strings which broke our installer key-match code. put the exact regex fix we recommend.

alex: will include the regex and a test harness. i'm also adding network notes for mirrors behind proxies + MTU caveats (customers saw corruption with 9000 MTU and older proxies). suggested line: "If using jumbo frames, validate mirrored transfers with `rsync --checksum` and test with MTU path discovery tools."

ci-bot: link-check: failed  broken link: docs/private-install/mirror-setup.md -> internal kb://mirror-policy not found

dmitri: replace kb link with our public FAQ and add a short redirect in docs config. i'll push the fix.

lia: small UX nit — add a short section on purging old packages to avoid disk exhaustion: example `find /srv/repos -type f -mtime +90 -delete` and suggest retention policy 90-365 days depending on compliance.

priya: could we add a tiny verification matrix for different OSes (ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, rhel8, rhel9)? customers appreciate exact commands per distro.

alex: yes, i'll add a table and per-distro commands. final ask: can someone validate the rpm signing flow with our staging softhsm before i merge? i don't have a test env this afternoon.

dmitri: i can run the softhsm test in staging at ~1600 PST and report back.

alex: thanks! assigning reviewers @priya @dmitri. aiming to merge after CI is green and the softhsm run.
